title.narrative: IDF Integration of Ethnic Minority Concerns in Poverty Reduction Strategies, Programs, and Monitoring

description.narrative: The objective is to assist the country to develop institutional capacity to monitor and evaluate impact of pverty reduction and growth policies on ethnic minorities and promote national dialogue on ethnic groups and development through: Component 1: Strengthening of Lao Front for National construction to better serve ethnic minorities through identifying their strengths and weaknessees and developing an action planto improve capacity for monitoring impacts and promoting dialogue on ethnic minorities. Component 2: Developing Monitroing and Evaluation system: through identifyin key impacts to be monitored, targets and indicators; developing method and tols for regular collection of information; and data processing, report preparation and dissemination, creating a library of reports and studies in Lao Language. The DO for this grant is to assist the country in developing institutional capacity of the LFNC, both at the national and at the local level to monitor and evaluate the impacts on ethinic minorities of priority NGPES policies, and to promote national policy dialogue concerning ethnic groups and development. It also aims to improve the understanding of the particular circumstances of ethnic minorities in Lao PDR.
